import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 15;
    static final int MAXM = 100005;
    static final int MAXNODE = MAXN * MAXN * 2 + 5;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;
    static final int[] dx = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static final int[] dy = {1, -1, 0, 0};

    static char[][] E = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] F = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int n, lim, sx, sy, S, T, tot;
    static int[][] idcell = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] distZ = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] mark = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] qq = new int[MAXM];
    static int[] level = new int[MAXNODE];
    static int[] it = new int[MAXNODE];
    static int[][] distC = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static Pt[] Pq = new Pt[MAXM];
    static List<FlowEdge>[] g = new ArrayList[MAXNODE];

    static class Pt {
        int x, y;
        Pt() {}
        Pt(int x, int y) { this.x = x; this.y = y; }
    }

    static class FlowEdge {
        int to, rev, cap;
        FlowEdge(int to, int rev, int cap) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }

    static boolean valid(int x, int y) {
        if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= n || y >= n || mark[x][y] == 1 || E[x][y] < '0' || E[x][y] > '9') return false;
        return true;
    }

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
        FlowEdge fwd = new FlowEdge(v, g[v].size(), c);
        FlowEdge rev = new FlowEdge(u, g[u].size(), 0);
        g[u].add(fwd);
        g[v].add(rev);
    }

    static void bfsZ() {
        int l = 1, r = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(distZ[i], INF);
        distZ[sx][sy] = 0;
        Pq[++r] = new Pt(sx, sy);
        mark[sx][sy] = 1;
        while (l <= r) {
            int ax = Pq[l].x, ay = Pq[l].y;
            l++;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = ax + dx[k], ny = ay + dy[k];
                if (valid(nx, ny)) {
                    distZ[nx][ny] = distZ[ax][ay] + 1;
                    mark[nx][ny] = 1;
                    Pq[++r] = new Pt(nx, ny);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void findLinks(int tx, int ty, int node) {
        int l = 1, r = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(mark[i], 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(distC[i], INF);
        mark[tx][ty] = 1;
        distC[tx][ty] = 0;
        Pq[++r] = new Pt(tx, ty);
        while (l <= r) {
            int ax = Pq[l].x, ay = Pq[l].y;
            l++;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = ax + dx[k], ny = ay + dy[k];
                if (valid(nx, ny)) {
                    distC[nx][ny] = distC[ax][ay] + 1;
                    mark[nx][ny] = 1;
                    if (distC[nx][ny] < distZ[nx][ny]) {
                        Pq[++r] = new Pt(nx, ny);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (distC[i][j] <= lim && F[i][j] > '0' && F[i][j] <= '9' && distC[i][j] <= distZ[i][j]) {
                    addEdge(node, idcell[i][j] + tot, INF);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean bfsLevel() {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        level[S] = 0;
        q.add(S);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (FlowEdge e : g[u]) {
                if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == -1) {
                    level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.add(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[T] != -1;
    }

    static int dfs(int u, int flow) {
        if (u == T) return flow;
        for (int i = it[u]; i < g[u].size(); i++) {
            it[u] = i;
            FlowEdge e = g[u].get(i);
            if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == level[u] + 1) {
                int ret = dfs(e.to, Math.min(flow, e.cap));
                if (ret > 0) {
                    e.cap -= ret;
                    g[e.to].get(e.rev).cap += ret;
                    return ret;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int maxflow() {
        int ans = 0;
        while (bfsLevel()) {
            Arrays.fill(it, 0);
            int f;
            while ((f = dfs(S, INF)) > 0) ans += f;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        lim = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) E[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) F[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
        }

        // Find Z
        sx = -1; sy = -1;
        outer:
        for (sx = 0; sx < n; sx++) {
            for (sy = 0; sy < n; sy++) {
                if (E[sx][sy] == 'Z') break outer;
            }
        }

        // Initialize idcell
        tot = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) idcell[i][j] = ++tot;

        S = 2 * tot + 1;
        T = S + 1;

        // Initialize graph
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXNODE; i++) g[i] = new ArrayList<>();

        // BFS from Z
        bfsZ();

        // Add edges from source to E cells and find links
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (E[i][j] > '0' && E[i][j] <= '9') {
                    addEdge(S, idcell[i][j], E[i][j] - '0');
                    findLinks(i, j, idcell[i][j]);
                }
            }
        }

        // Add edges from F cells to sink
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (F[i][j] > '0' && F[i][j] <= '9') {
                    addEdge(idcell[i][j] + tot, T, F[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(maxflow());
        sc.close();
    }
}
